Crafted in Slovakia to original GAT standards, from a rich burgundy Horween Chromexcel® leather, renowned for softness and durability.

Please note: Due to the production process natural marks and scratches occur on the leather.

This product is crafted from carefully sourced leather. As a natural material variations are intentional, contributing to the individuality and authenticity of the product. With time and wear, the leather will soften, age, and distress, developing a rich patina. To help preserve its original characteristics, we recommend occasional treatment with neutral leather conditioner using a soft brush.
